integrity: The upper bound is proved by a geodesic two-front witness lemma; a separate exhaustive computation checks every unlabeled tree through order 17.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary one-dimensional color refinement from the uniform coloring is treated.
The theorem gives the extremal value over trees but does not classify every extremal tree.
The computational verification is finite and supplements rather than replaces the all-order proof.
title: Sharp half-order upper bound for color-refinement depth on trees
